## Hint 2
```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}
    % (left) one quarter of the circle: two radii and the chord between their ends
    \begin{scope}[shift={(0,0)}]  
      \def\R{1.6}

      \colorlet{sqcol}{red!65!black}     % dark red: square sides
      \colorlet{circcol}{blue!65!black}  % dark blue: circle
      \draw[circ] (0,0) circle (\R);
      \draw[seg, dashed] (-\R,0) -- (0,0) -- node[below, font=\footnotesize]{$r$}(\R,0);
      \draw[seg, dashed] (0,-\R) -- (0,\R);
      \draw[seg]
        (\R,0)  -- node[below=0pt, font=\footnotesize] {$x$}
        (0,\R)  -- node[below=0pt, font=\footnotesize] {$x$}
        (-\R,0) -- node[above=0pt, font=\footnotesize] {$x$}
        (0,-\R) -- node[above=0pt, font=\footnotesize] {$x$}
        cycle;
      \node[center dot] at (0,0) {};
      % C call-out pointing to the circle
      \node(Clbl) at (\R+0.8,\R+0.2) {$C$};
      \draw[callout] (Clbl) -- (45:\R+0.05);
      \node[center dot] at (0,0) {};
      \node[align=left] at (0,-2.6)
      {$C > \:x+x+x+x$};
    \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}}
```
:::

### Solution

**Answer: B. 11**

Following the order of operations (PEMDAS), do the multiplication first:

$4 \times 2 = 8$, then $3 + 8 = 11$.

### Hint

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Hint 1
Think about the order of operations.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Hint 2
Multiplication comes before addition. What is $4 \times 2$?
:::

### Solution

**Answer: B. 11**

Following the order of operations (PEMDAS), do the multiplication first:

$4 \times 2 = 8$, then $3 + 8 = 11$.

:::

## Submit

```{=html}
<button id="submit-quiz" class="btn btn-primary">Submit</button>
<div id="quiz-results" style="margin-top: 1em;"></div>

<script>
  // Stores each student's choice, keyed by question name
  const choices = {};

  // Record a choice whenever a radio button changes
  document.querySelectorAll(".quiz-question").forEach(form => {
    form.addEventListener("change", e => {
      choices[form.dataset.question] = e.target.value;
    });
  });

  // Score the quiz on submit
  document.getElementById("submit-quiz").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const questions = document.querySelectorAll(".quiz-question");
    let score = 0;
    let details = "";

    questions.forEach(form => {
      const name = form.dataset.question;
      const picked = choices[name];
      const correct = picked === form.dataset.answer;
      if (correct) score++;
      details += `<li>${name}: ${picked ? picked.toUpperCase() : "no answer"} ` +
                 `${correct ? "✅" : "❌"}</li>`;
    });

    document.getElementById("quiz-results").innerHTML =
      `<h3>Score: ${score} / ${questions.length}</h3><ul>${details}</ul>`;
  });
</script>
```
